label.zh: 两个信号追踪（顺序不限）

note.zh: 两个“信号踪迹”项目互不依赖；两者都完成后，才开放“未爆装置”项目。
note.en: The two Signal Trace projects are independent; once both are done, the Undetonated Device project opens.

notes.zh: 随机遗址：权重+50，出现在有毒星球（pc_toxic，非地形改造候选）上，要求 has_shroud_dlc（common/archaeological_site_types/12_extreme_frontiers_arc_sites.txt:302）。
notes.en: A random site: +50 on toxic planets (pc_toxic, not a terraforming candidate), needing has_shroud_dlc (common/archaeological_site_types/12_extreme_frontiers_arc_sites.txt:302).

scope.zh: 整条故事：遗址的出现方式、全部阶段（按定义顺序）、最后结果及其互斥关系、掷骰失败时的事件池；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: how the site appears, every stage in definition order, the final outcome(s) and their exclusivity, the roll-failure incident pool; both languages read.
